# DropSpace 1.1 Beta5

<!-- update-summary: Centralizes NetEase enhancement management in DLC, clarifies installed component groups, and fixes unresponsive installation controls after removal. -->

## Changes

- Music keeps a single NetEase enhancement navigation entry below media application settings. Installation, update, reinstall and removal belong to Settings → DLC.
- DLC consistently groups the enhancement with installed or not-installed components. Active operations retain their position and display installer stages, progress, cancellation and actionable errors.
- Moving an enhancement between inventory groups creates a fresh card lifetime, preventing the install button from becoming unresponsive after removal.
- Forced reinstalls skip the redundant pre-install media verification. Post-install verification, managed-file ownership and rollback remain in place.
- Component classification and empty-state terminology now describe installation status in all ten interface languages.

The immediate development and upgrade baseline is v1.1.0-beta.4 at
648cc6d856f558367b4c598220e9b403a67ef68a. Beta3 lyric matching and Beta4 liquid glass,
music-window integration, global lyric target placement and higher-resolution artwork are retained.

## Validation

This is an unpublished development candidate. See the Beta5 migration section in
[the validation record](../../docs/dev/netease-enhancement-ui-20261029.md) for checks
performed on this baseline. Earlier Beta2-based results are historical and are not
presented as Beta5 verification. Existing native heap stability limitations remain.
